title: Farmers hire an ass to protect their sheep 🫏🐑
caption:
Foxes, beware. The ass is on duty 🫏🛡️
Tag a farmer 👇
first_comment: Would you trust a donkey with your sheep? 👇
sources: Ontario Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs (OMAFRA), 'Guard donkeys for livestock protection' (single jennies or geldings, natural dislike of canines, braying, chasing, kicking)
Texas A&M AgriLife Extension, 'Using guard donkeys to protect sheep and goats' (one donkey per flock works best)
